name: dataInner_traceChar
summary: Lift t, write the Heisenberg translate of the named datum as a translate of the character and compute the pairing place by place.

steps.claim: Lift t to a matrix u over the integral adeles (reduction is surjective).

The Heisenberg action on the integrated datum splits into the real coordinate on v and the finite one on the named character datum (rho_integrated_realCoord, dataInner_integrated); a named character translates into a multiple of itself times its projection (name_char_eq_translate_projOn); the pairing of the characters is the value of the character at the finite coordinate (trace and additive character identities).
steps.lean:
erw [rho_integrated_realCoord, dataInner_integrated, (_ : _ ∘ vecToMat = _),
    𝔪.name_char_eq_translate_projOn _ (matToVec u ∘ swap), ϱ_swap,
    map_smul] <;> simp +contextual [-Heisenberg.Rep.mul, funext_iff, finVec, ↓← rho_integrated,
    matToVec, finCoord, trace, adelicHeis, Matrix.mul_apply, ← map_mul, ← map_sum, stdForm,
    stdAddChar, dotProduct, fst_sum, snd_sum, ← Circle.coe_pow, ← AddChar.map_nsmul_eq_pow, two_mul,
    ← add_mul, ← map_add, mul_mem] <;> simp [stdLattice.psi₀_apply, Finset.mul_sum, sum_prod_type,
    mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm (u ..).1]
